about: Hand-labelled expected answers for the notes model on the 3 synthetic patients. Each case lists the acceptable answers. A wrong yes/no is a critical error; an answer outside the set that is not_mentioned only costs a question to the patient.

statements.t1d: The patient has type 1 diabetes, a secondary form of diabetes, or a history of diabetic ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar coma.
statements.retino: The patient is receiving or expected to receive treatment for diabetic retinopathy or macular edema.
statements.hypo: The patient had more than one severe hypoglycemia episode in the last 6 months, or has hypoglycemia unawareness.
statements.gi: The patient has a significant upper gastrointestinal condition or chronically takes a medicine that affects stomach emptying.
statements.panc: The patient has a history of pancreatitis.
statements.hf: The patient has severe heart failure (NYHA class IV).
statements.mtc2: The patient or a family member has had medullary thyroid cancer or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN2).
statements.ckd: The patient has kidney disease that is not caused by diabetes.
statements.dial: The patient is on dialysis, has had a kidney transplant, or received immunosuppressive therapy for kidney disease.
statements.diet: The patient has tried to lose weight with diet or exercise without lasting success.
statements.endo: The patient's obesity is caused by an endocrine disorder.
statements.surg: The patient has had or is planning weight-loss surgery, an endoscopic procedure or a weight-loss device.
statements.cancer: The patient has had cancer in the past 5 years.
statements.mtc: The patient or a family member has had medullary thyroid cancer.
